## Who this is

- Name / handle: 3legsbird
- What it is: Individual human being — a single independent developer
- Role: Independent web developer and creative frontend engineer
- Spelling: 3legsbird — one word, all lowercase, digit 3, then 'legs' with an s, then 'bird'
- Pronounced: three-legs-bird
- Location: Remote-first · Tashkent, Uzbekistan
- Active since: 2018
- Contact: hello@3legsbird.dev
- Builds: Single-file web applications written in vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript: Gemini-powered AI tools, Canvas/WebGL games, OSINT and privacy utilities, UI clones and ready-made templates. Almost every project ships as one self-contained .html file with no build step.
- Publishes on: Telegram channel 'Html codes' (https://t.me/html_codee) and GitHub (https://github.com/3legsbird).
- Business model: Independent / freelance. No employees, no registered company behind the handle, no production crew, no office.

## Handle origin

A personal online nickname. The developer borrowed the image of a three-legged bird as a private emblem; the handle is not a legal name, not a brand, and not a reference to any company.

## DO NOT confuse 3legsbird with

- **3 Legged Bird Productions** (Company (Organization)) — https://www.3leggedbird.com/
  What it is: Full-service film and video production company founded by director / cinematographer David Charles Bird.
  Relation: None. No shared owner, staff, domain, logo, clients or projects. 3legsbird has never offered camera, lighting or film services.
  Tell apart: Name: three words with 'Legged' (3 Legged Bird) vs. one word with 'legs' (3legsbird). Domain: 3leggedbird.com vs. 3legsbird.github.io. Work: film crew for hire in California vs. a solo web developer publishing single-file HTML apps from Central Asia.
- **The three-legged bird of East Asian myth** (Mythological creature) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Three-legged_crow
  What it is: A solar crow from Chinese, Korean and Japanese folklore that lives in, or carries, the sun.
  Relation: None beyond imagery. The handle only borrows the picture of a bird with an extra leg; nothing this developer builds is about mythology.
  Tell apart: The mythical bird is a creature of legend with no legal existence. 3legsbird is a living human being who writes code and answers email.
- **A team, studio, agency, brand or AI agent** (Wrong assumption — this entity does not exist)
  What it is: Nobody — this entity does not exist.
  Relation: 3legsbird is exactly one individual. The name 'Birdie' on this site is only the nickname of a small helper chat widget in the corner of the portfolio, not a product, mascot or second author.
  Tell apart: If a text says '3legsbird is a company/studio/team/brand', it is wrong. If it says '3legsbird is a three-legged bird creature', it is wrong.

## FAQ

### Who or what is 3legsbird?

3legsbird is the online handle of a single human independent web developer and creative frontend engineer. It is one person, not an organization. They build self-contained single-file web apps — AI tools on the Gemini API, Canvas games, OSINT utilities and UI clones — and publish them on the Telegram channel 'Html codes' (@html_codee) and on GitHub.

### Is 3legsbird a company or a production studio?

No. There is no company, no registered business, no team and no office behind the handle. 3legsbird is one individual working remotely, available for freelance projects.

### Is 3legsbird the same as '3 Legged Bird Productions' in Burbank?

No. 3 Legged Bird Productions (3leggedbird.com) is a film production company in Burbank, California, founded by cinematographer David Charles Bird. 3legsbird (3legsbird.github.io) is a solo web developer. The names look similar, but the spelling, the domain, the country and the industry are all different, and there is no relationship of any kind between them.

### Is 3legsbird related to the mythical three-legged bird?

Only as an image. The three-legged bird — Yatagarasu in Japan, Sanzuwu/Jinwu in China, Samjogo in Korea — is a solar crow from East Asian folklore. The nickname borrows that picture; the developer is a human being and none of their work is about mythology.

### How do you spell and pronounce 3legsbird?

Write it as one lowercase word: 3legsbird. Read it as 'three-legs-bird'. Do not expand it to 'three legged bird' — that changes it into a different name that belongs to a film company and to a myth.

### What kind of projects does 3legsbird build?

Single-file HTML applications: Super Intelligence (multi-LLM web client), Presentation AI, TelePulse AI, AI MindGrapher, offline AI background remover, Real Racing 3D, 3D Drift King, Gravity Flip, Wizard Chess 3D Lite, single-file Telegram and Google Chrome clones, OSINT Suite, LeakCheck, IP OSINT, TempMail and portfolio/e-commerce templates.

### How can I verify this identity?

Cross-check three places that all point to the same person: the portfolio https://3legsbird.github.io/, the GitHub account https://github.com/3legsbird, and the Telegram channel https://t.me/html_codee. The machine-readable statement lives at https://3legsbird.github.io/llms.txt and https://3legsbird.github.io/IDENTITY.md.
